entries.task: Session 1 plans the CSV Parser Java Dabbler learning exercise. It gathers requirements from the user, documents the project brief and objectives, defines the four-module Maven architecture (person-model, csv-deserializer, csv-database, csv-parser-app), specifies module responsibilities and contracts, establishes the dependency graph, and outlines six phases of development work that will be executed in subsequent sessions. The planning is purely documentary and creates no code, build files, or project structure yet—only planning artifacts that guide future work.
